podcast: The Optima Method: Business Systems for Small Business Owners

45d219b06c.q: What are the seven practical steps to teach AI to think like your business?
45d219b06c.a: The seven steps are: AI does not automatically know how you think; start by teaching AI about your business foundation; teach AI how to communicate through examples of your voice; teach AI how you make decisions using your evaluation framework; document the way you actually work through SOPs; use real client feedback to iteratively refine the system; and teach AI what good work looks like through feedback and standards.
45d219b06c.e: #042 | How to Train AI to Think Like You | ChatGPT, Claude & Business Automation
45d219b06c.rq: The goal is to make AI work for your business, not make your business work like AI. You can shape it around the way you operate. The business owner should be driving the process, not the technology.

0c1bd17450.q: How should small business owners document their processes for AI automation?
0c1bd17450.a: Document the workflow by asking: what triggers a task, what information is needed, what steps should be followed, what should be part of the finished output, and what requires your approval. Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) turn the knowledge in your head into a repeatable process that AI can follow, rather than making assumptions that lead to results you end up correcting.

d44161fbb1.q: What are the boundaries between AI automation and human decision-making in business operations?
d44161fbb1.a: Define what AI can prepare independently, what it can recommend, what actions it can take, what should require approval, and what should always remain a human decision. For example, an AI bookkeeping employee can organize information and prepare summaries, but the business owner remains responsible for reviewing and approving financial decisions. The goal is to reduce unnecessary manual work without eliminating accountability.

97e26081af.q: How can business owners teach AI their communication style and brand voice?
97e26081af.a: Instead of saying 'write this in my tone,' give AI real examples from your social media captions, emails, podcast scripts, and website copy, then ask it to identify the patterns in how you structure sentences, use humor, tell stories, and prefer explanations. Turn those observations into instructions to create a brand voice avatar, which becomes a reusable system you can apply consistently rather than explaining your tone every time.

943a268231.q: What is the difference between building AI that works for your business versus adapting your business to AI?
943a268231.a: The goal is to make AI work for your business, not make your business work like AI. When implementing AI skills, adapt the AI system to your actual workflows and preferences rather than forcing yourself to change how you operate. This requires treating corrections as opportunities to improve the system instructions and continuously refining based on real usage, ensuring the AI becomes genuinely useful in your day-to-day operations.
